text: The principal dipped-beam LED modules shall produce an objective luminous flux of 2,500 lumens.
notes: Requires automatic headlamp cleaning per UNECE R48 Clause 6.2.7.3

text: Direction-indicator lamps shall flash at an operating frequency of 2.5 Hz.
notes: Frequency exceeds statutory 1.5 +/- 0.5 Hz bound (UNECE R48 6.5.9)

text: Front fog lamps shall provide sufficient illumination under normal conditions.
notes: Vague term 'sufficient illumination' without numeric photometric thresholds

text: The dipped-beam headlamp must be weatherproof and never fail during the vehicle lifetime.
notes: Untestable blanket claim lacking defined ISO/environmental test standard

text: Daytime running lamps shall remain illuminated at full power when dipped-beam headlamps are turned on.
notes: DRLs must turn off automatically when headlamps are switched on (UNECE R48 6.19.7.2)

text: The stop lamp apparent surface shall be located at a mounting height of 280 mm above the ground.
notes: Minimum mounting height is 350 mm above ground (UNECE R48 6.7.4.2)

text: The driving beam shall emit amber light to enhance nighttime contrast.
notes: Driving beam must be White per UNECE R48 5.15

text: Dipped-beam cut-off line downward inclination shall be set promptly by the driver during driving.
notes: Subjective adverb 'promptly' and unclear automatic/manual leveling specification

text: Direction-indicator lamps must switch on independently of other lamps and flash at 90 periods per minute.
notes: Compliant baseline requirement meeting UNECE R48 6.5.7 and 6.5.9

text: Dipped-beam headlamps with total luminous flux of 1,500 lumens shall be installed at a height of 750 mm above the ground.
notes: Compliant baseline requirement (flux <= 2000 lm, height within 500-1200 mm)
